purpose: Causal initialization and supported CLI control; no production admission or native streaming qualification

shared_runtime_wheel.license: Repository-root Apache-2.0 notice retained; wheel itself contains no licence member. Private evaluation only, no redistribution or production provenance approval.

budget_contract.production_compute_threads: available_parallelism().min(2); tilo_speech_threads accepts only 1 or 2, passed as Whisper params.n_threads
budget_contract.review_guard: probe.observe(max_threads=2) counts all native tasks using /proc Threads, not only running compute workers
budget_contract.scope_cpu: two admitted CPUs and CPUQuota=200%; independent of thread count
budget_contract.interpretation: The review guard is stricter than a compute setting. Observed extra tasks are the engine compute pool, not independently established support threads; no exemption or limit relaxation.

causal_findings.archive: Whistle Engine() fallback calls libc++ thread::hardware_concurrency(), then min(result-or-one,12); ThreadPool(count) launches indices 1 through count-1 and the caller participates. Its separate affinity/topology code chooses placement, not this fallback count.
causal_findings.current_shared_runtime: Matching Whistle constructor field offset 0xed8 and cap-12 sequence at virtual address 0xc8dd5; target 0x176970 calls sysconf with _SC_NPROCESSORS_ONLN (0x54 on this Linux runtime), reporting 64 online CPUs rather than admitted affinity. No private entry point was invoked.
causal_findings.environment_guesses: OMP_NUM_THREADS, OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS and NEEDLE_THREADS were not supported controls and did not constrain this pool
causal_findings.thread_role: 11 engine compute-pool workers plus the calling thread; worker_loop executes parallel_for jobs, initially spins then sleeps on a condition variable
causal_findings.supported_cli_configuration: --threads 2 created exactly one CLONE_THREAD task in a traced full-French-fixture control, pinned to CPU 1; no transient 12-thread CLI pool was observed in the syscall trace
causal_findings.supported_native_configuration: No thread-setting function in the exact public header or 11 needle_* exports. Wrapper selects/fetches/loads the shared library but supplies no thread setter.

startup_snapshot.interpretation: Partial snapshot: calling thread plus three idle workers observed before immediate guard termination; the remaining eight tasks were not sampled individually. Worker CPU was about 1 ms each, wchan futex_do_wait. Do not claim all 11 workers were idle or that future inference cannot activate them.
startup_snapshot.earlier_setup_failure: One diagnostic scope stopped before decoder because its shared-library verification path was stale; corrected without changing any budget. The following snapshot needed per-line flushing; both guard-refused attempts are retained.

traced_cli_control.interpretation: strace instrumentation; complete-file decoding. Do not use traced timing or CPU accounting as source-paced latency.

one_thread_paced_french_control.controlled_change: Supported CLI --threads 2 to --threads 1 only; same public PCM, model, language, single-pass prefix schedule, two-CPU affinity and all admission guards
one_thread_paced_french_control.interpretation: One builder observation per setting. One thread lowers measured CPU and virtual memory but worsens final delay; early Merci remains incorrect. Not a shipping or resident streaming improvement.

upstream_fix_required.scope: Exact licensed native runtime source or a publisher-supported API; broader Cactus source is not verified compatible
upstream_fix_required.proposal: Add a public pre-load thread option, validated as positive and applied to Whistle Engine/ThreadPool construction. Explicit thread count must be constrained to admitted affinity; fallback should also respect affinity. Applying it only after default construction would still transiently violate the guard.
validation_needed: At most 2 total native tasks from startup through inference; syscall and /proc evidence
Resident source-paced public streaming: actual lexical first words and accuracy
Repeat, silence, cancellation and complete model/runtime provenance
upstream_fix_required.performed: No runtime patch, private ABI invocation, interposer, new signature, installation, deployment, microphone or catalogue grant
